description: Road location and traffic data is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. This dataset contains the Department of Transport and Main Roads road location details (both spatial and through distance) as well as associated traffic data on the state-controlled road network. Coverage: Transport and Main Roads. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are chainage, spine file, through distance, traffic data, transport. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2026-08-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
